core_connection.text: Hill Landscaping is the landscaping company that looks after the yard at Mia's South Bay home. It started with a fall cleanup in 2024, moved to monthly maintenance in 2026, and later built a backyard gravel and patio area.

evidence.quote: fall yard cleanup at our home in South Bay
set up monthly maintenance starting in April

facts.text: Hill Landscaping is the landscaping company Mia hires for her home in South Bay.

evidence.quote: fall yard cleanup at our home in South Bay

facts.text: Victor lives in Mia's household and opens the side gate for the crew.

evidence.quote: Victor will be home to open the side gate.

facts.text: The 2024 fall cleanup covered trimming two olive trees in the front yard, removing leaves, cutting back the lavender and hauling away green waste.

evidence.quote: Trim the two olive trees in the front yard
Cut back the overgrown lavender along the walkway

facts.text: Mia asks for flat-price estimates and sends photos with her requests.

evidence.quote: Please let us know a flat-price estimate

facts.text: In October 2024, Mia offered weekday afternoons after 3 PM or Saturday, October 19 for the estimate visit.

evidence.quote: Any weekday after 3:00 PM works for the estimate visit

facts.text: The fall cleanup was booked for Thursday, October 24, 2024 at 8:00 AM.

evidence.quote: Please book Thursday, October 24 at 8:00 AM.

facts.text: Access: the side gate is left unlocked, and the green waste bins are on the left side of the driveway.

evidence.quote: The side gate will be unlocked
green waste bins are on the left side of the driveway

facts.text: In March 2026, Mia set up monthly maintenance starting in April. It covers mowing the front lawn, edging, weeding the planter beds and checking the sprinkler heads.

evidence.quote: Mowing the front lawn, edging, weeding the planter beds

facts.text: Mia confirmed the monthly maintenance agreement with a one-word reply.
Mia was happy with the fall cleanup.

evidence.quote: Thank you again for the great work on our fall cleanup

facts.text: The 2026 backyard project started on Monday, August 17 at 8:00 AM.

evidence.quote: Monday, August 17 at 8:00 AM works for us

facts.text: Mia supplied the backyard materials herself: weed fabric and 3 cubic yards of dark gray 3/8-inch gravel, delivered to the driveway on Friday, August 14.

evidence.quote: 3 cubic yards of dark gray 3/8-inch gravel
delivered to the driveway on Friday, August 14

facts.text: Mia was delighted with the finished backyard, sent photos of the patio and gravel area, and paid the invoice through the online link in August 2026.

evidence.quote: I've paid the invoice through the online link
Victor will be home to open the side gate.
